description: x402 seller preflight: check a paid endpoint BEFORE paying. Probes it unpaid, parses the 402 (v2 header or v1 body) and checks each option: scheme, network, asset is real USDC on Base, EIP-712 name/version match on-chain, payTo not a burn address, amount, timeout, discovery metadata. Plus on-chain seller reputation: recent USDC payments to payTo (last ~11 h: distinct payers, total, last payment). Returns verdict ok/caution/fail, issues and the recommended option. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call (x402).

days.description: on-chain payer history window in days (default 3; at most ~11 h is scanned per call, see windowHoursCovered)

url.description: https URL of the x402-paid endpoint

name: x402_preflight
